_about: Director layout for V07 page 10. Units: pt, origin top-left. Three Tez-only beats: a tall explanation, a close-up line of dialogue, then a small inset where Tez turns to the reader, with the reader call-out set on the page background (Opening p04 style).
hierarchy: Tall left panel carries the longest narration; the right column steps down from dialogue to the reader call-out so the page ends by addressing the reader.

panels.compose: Portrait medium close-up of Tez seated beside the emergency hatch, right forepaw extended towards the closed gate. Tez occupies the lower 62% of the frame. Top 25% calm (shadowed gate leaves) for a six-line caption.

Low eye-level medium close-up of Tez sitting upright, both forepaws on the paving, in the right 60% of the frame with his head at about 45% down. Upper-left 62% x 30% calm for a four-line speech balloon.
Small portrait inset. Tez standing beside the hatch, facing the viewer, right forepaw lifted towards the viewer with the pad partly visible, eyes on the reader. Whole body visible, centred.
